_about: Config of pipeline/rig/prepare_rig.py for a hunched crossbowman with the crossbow modelled on his back. World coordinates in the rest pose (m, character front = -Y, back = +Y). Measure them on your own model.

select._: stock; the quiver above it is excluded

frame._: prop X axis = stock from butt to front; 'up' = the side facing away from the back (Y)

grow._: pulls string ends (thin cylinders) into the prop

debris._: body islands left after the cut, smaller than max and fully inside the box, are deleted

fingers._: distances from the wrist along the hand axis (m); claws split at different heights: main ones from 0.21, the thumb from 0.17. Optional "thumb": {"Right": k} overrides the guessed thumb
